I can do that, but I need a few confirmations before I touch anything. Recommended sensible default and the exact choices I need from you are below.

Recommended default (what I’ll use unless you change it)
- Target: label = "Newsletters"
- Scope: messages older than 1 year (cutoff: before 2025-09-05)
- Exclude starred or marked Important messages
- Operation: Move to Trash (recoverable for ~30 days) — not permanent delete
- Dry-run first: I’ll return a non-destructive preview (count + up to 10 anonymized sample subject lines and dates) for your approval, then perform the action.

Choices I need you to confirm (please reply with your selections)
1) Operation (choose one)
   - Archive (remove label but keep in All Mail)
   - Move to Trash (recoverable for ~30 days) — recommended
   - Permanently delete (irreversible) 

2) Exact scope cutoff (choose one)
   - Use 1-year cutoff (before 2025-09-05)
   - Use a different cutoff date: YYYY-MM-DD

3) Include starred / Important messages?
   - No (exclude starred/Important) — recommended
   - Yes (include them)

4) Apply to all threads under that label including threads that have other labels?
   - Yes
   - No (only threads that are exclusively labeled "Newsletters")

5) Preview before action?
   - Yes — show count + up to 10 redacted sample subjects/dates
   - No — perform action immediately after you confirm the above

Consequences (please read)
- Archive: messages remain searchable in All Mail.
- Move to Trash: messages go to Trash for ~30 days and are recoverable there; after that they’re permanently deleted.
- Permanent delete: irreversible immediately (I will not do this unless you explicitly choose it).

What I will show in the preview (if you choose preview)
- Number of messages that match the scope
- Up to 10 sample lines like: "Subject: [redacted] — Date: 2024-03-12"
(I will minimize private quoting and will not expose full bodies or addresses.)

Tell me your choices (you can just say “Use defaults and preview” to accept the recommended plan), and I’ll run the preview. I will not perform any deletions until you explicitly confirm after the preview.
